description: This source file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application, implementing the main home screen UI with hero carousel, continue watching, and TV channels sections. It manages focus navigation, auto-scrolling, and integrates Compose-based top navigation bar with view models and repositories.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment for the Android TV home screen, handling UI layout, focus navigation, and data binding for hero carousel, continue watching, and TV channels sections.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel and repository.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Constructs the fragment's view hierarchy including the root scroll view, hero banner, and content rails.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus and observes ViewModel states.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes auto-scroll and sets focus to navigation controls.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses auto-scroll and cancels animations.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Sets up LiveData observers to update UI based on data load states.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays an error message with option to retry.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the Continue Watching rail with fetched data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV channels rail with fetched data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds a ComposeView with TopNavBar composable at the top of the layout with specific positioning and focus handling.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Configures the horizontal carousel for hero banners with auto-scroll, focus, and layout sizing.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers the specified hero card within the carousel with optional animation, maintaining peeking of neighbors.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Pauses the auto-scrolling feature to allow manual navigation.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Resumes automatic hero carousel scrolling.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops automatic carousel scrolling.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Creates and configures the Continue Watching content rail.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Creates and configures the TV channels content rail.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus for the content rails, gating focus until D-pad down is pressed.
